captions: Ifan weighed Moss today and found out his breed, and Winnie wants his record put right.
Every query so far only reads, so the change waits until Ifan has a moment.
You add, change and remove rows, and undo a change, in four tasks.
Now Moss's row is up to date, and no other animal was touched.
Same records, now kept up to date at the desk, one careful change at a time.
